inputs.name: JevAdapter.constructor.config
inputs.description: The required TypeSafe client configuration supplies the API key and model; fetch, timeout, and maxRetries are optional. The adapter uses https://api.typesafe.ai, defaults timeout to 10000 ms and retries to 2, and caps retry-after at 5000 ms.

inputs.name: JevAdapter.evaluate.request
inputs.description: A JevRequest contains the required state string and a record of choice questions keyed by ID. It is sent to systemOne with the configured model, and its question keys determine which response answers are validated.

inputs.name: JevAdapter.evaluate.signal
inputs.description: An optional AbortSignal lets the caller cancel evaluation and is combined with an adapter-created 30-second deadline. If it is already aborted, evaluate throws immediately; if either signal aborts during the request, the adapter reports cancellation or timeout.

outputs.name: JevAdapter.evaluate
outputs.description: The Promise resolves to the validator's JevEvaluation: a model name, an answers record containing choice, confidence, and per-option probabilities, and input/output token counts. Validation requires a Jev-formatted model, one answer for each supplied question, valid option keys and probabilities, and a matching model unless the configured model is jev-latest or jev-preview.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: The adapter throws or rejects with Error for an already-aborted signal, request or validation failures, API errors, cancellation, or deadline expiry. APIError becomes “Jev request failed (HTTP <status>).”, cancellation becomes “Jev review was cancelled or timed out.”, and all other caught failures, including model mismatch, become “Jev request or response validation failed.”
